lines.zh: 我悬在半空，书页当腿。
lines.en: I hover in the air and use my pages as legs.

lines.zh: 页角扫过地面，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My page corners sweep the ground and whisper.

lines.zh: 我飘得不快，但从不落地。
lines.en: I drift slowly, but I never touch down.

lines.zh: 我的书脊裂了，字还在走。
lines.en: My spine is split, yet the letters still walk.

lines.zh: 翻一页，我就前进一尺。
lines.en: One turned page and I advance a foot.

lines.zh: 风吹开我，我自己合上。
lines.en: The wind opens me, and I close myself.

lines.zh: 书页边缘在空气里划出声。
lines.en: My page edges cut a sound out of the air.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掉下墨点。
lines.en: I walk and drop ink spots as I go.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草会枯一点。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass withers a little.

lines.zh: 我不用脚，所以没有脚印。
lines.en: I have no feet, so I leave no prints.

lines.zh: 我的封皮在渗黑。
lines.en: My cover is sweating something black.

lines.zh: 我沿着书架投下的影子飘。
lines.en: I drift along the shadow a bookshelf casts.

lines.zh: 我合上自己，听里面的字争吵。
lines.en: I close myself and listen to the letters argue.

lines.zh: 页间漏出一线红光，我压住它。
lines.en: A red line leaks between pages; I press it shut.

lines.zh: 有只蠹虫在啃我，我让它啃。
lines.en: A bookworm chews me, and I let it.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢翻开我的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone brave enough to open me.

lines.zh: 封皮上的锁扣锈了，还是锁着。
lines.en: The clasp is rusted, and still it holds.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个读过我的人。
lines.en: I remember every person who ever read me.

lines.zh: 被放逐那天，我的页数是单数。
lines.en: The day I was banished, my page count was odd.

lines.zh: 我用页角摩挲石面，磨出沟。
lines.en: I rub stone with a page corner until it grooves.

lines.zh: 我数自己的字数，数不到头。
lines.en: I count my own words and never finish.

lines.zh: 里面的恶魔在午睡，别吵。
lines.en: The demon inside is napping; keep quiet.

lines.zh: 我的书名被刮掉了，只剩痕。
lines.en: My title was scraped off; only the scar remains.

lines.zh: 风吹过页缝，像有人在念。
lines.en: Wind through my pages sounds like recitation.

lines.zh: 我在墙角立着，装成普通书。
lines.en: I stand in a corner, posing as an ordinary book.

lines.zh: 墨迹在夜里自己重排。
lines.en: At night the ink rearranges itself.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖封皮，灰落下来。
lines.en: I shake my cover and dust falls away.

lines.zh: 我把一页翻回来，压住那道红。
lines.en: I turn a page back to hold the red down.

lines.zh: 你想读我？先把名字留下。
lines.en: Want to read me? Leave your name first.

lines.zh: 你的手停在半空，很好。
lines.en: Your hand stops in the air; good.

lines.zh: 我看见你眼里那点贪。
lines.en: I see that small greed in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你翻过禁书吗，翻过就懂。
lines.en: Have you opened a banned book? Then you understand.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝里有旧咒，我认得。
lines.en: There is an old curse in your seams; I know it.

lines.zh: 你盯我的封皮，我在看你的骨头。
lines.en: You study my cover; I study your bones.

lines.zh: 你带了手套，聪明的做法。
lines.en: You wore gloves; a clever choice.

lines.zh: 你在估我的价钱，我在估你的命。
lines.en: You price me; I appraise your life.

lines.zh: 这本书不适合在灯下读。
lines.en: This book is not meant for lamplight.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，说明你读到了一行。
lines.en: You blinked, so you read a line.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的页上，别动。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my page; hold still.

lines.zh: 我从书脊的缝里看你。
lines.en: I look at you through the gap in my spine.

lines.zh: 你退开，说明你听说了那个传说。
lines.en: You back away, so you heard the legend.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，夹在页里。
lines.en: I have saved your face, pressed between pages.

lines.zh: 你撕掉一页，我少了一句话。
lines.en: You tear out a page and I lose a sentence.

lines.zh: 纸被划开，里面流出黑的东西。
lines.en: The paper splits and something black runs out.

lines.zh: 我疼，疼得字都歪了。
lines.en: I hurt, and the pain tilts my letters.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被烧的那次。
lines.en: This reminds me of the time I was burned.

lines.zh: 我的封皮裂了，露出里面的牙。
lines.en: My cover splits and shows the teeth inside.

lines.zh: 你砍断了书脊，我还站得住。
lines.en: You broke my spine, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 墨溅出来，落在地上还在爬。
lines.en: Ink spills out and crawls across the floor.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，掉出两页咒文。
lines.en: I shudder and drop two pages of incantation.

lines.zh: 你伤的不是纸，是里面那位。
lines.en: You wounded the one inside, not the paper.

lines.zh: 别用火，那是我唯一怕的。
lines.en: Do not use fire; it is the one thing I fear.

lines.zh: 你手里那页羊皮，给我。
lines.en: That sheet of vellum in your hand, give it here.

lines.zh: 墨水，我闻到了墨水。
lines.en: Ink. I smell ink.

lines.zh: 把书签放下，我就安静。
lines.en: Set the bookmark down and I will be still.

lines.zh: 你抄的咒文写错了两处。
lines.en: You miscopied the incantation in two places.

lines.zh: 那本旧账本，烧了也可惜。
lines.en: That old ledger would be a shame to burn.

lines.zh: 我要的不是金子，是字。
lines.en: What I want is not gold but words.

lines.zh: 你把名字写在纸上，纸给我。
lines.en: Write your name on paper and hand me the paper.

lines.zh: 我饿，饿的是没读过的句子。
lines.en: I am hungry, and what I hunger for are unread sentences.

lines.zh: 你口袋里的信，念一句。
lines.en: The letter in your pocket, read me one line.

lines.zh: 一支笔就够了，我自带墨。
lines.en: A pen is enough; I bring my own ink.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，页角划破你的手。
lines.en: You strike me and a page corner cuts your hand.

lines.zh: 我的封皮比石头硬。
lines.en: My cover is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 书页散开，又自己合拢。
lines.en: My pages scatter, then gather themselves.

lines.zh: 这一撞，掉出来三页空白。
lines.en: The impact shakes out three blank pages.

lines.zh: 你被弹退，手上多了道血口。
lines.en: You are thrown back with a fresh cut on your hand.

lines.zh: 我飘着，撞你像撞一面幡。
lines.en: Floating, I hit you like a banner hitting.

lines.zh: 我贴着你滑过，留下墨痕。
lines.en: I slide along you and leave an ink smear.

lines.zh: 你别踩我的页，踩了要还。
lines.en: Do not step on my pages; there is a price.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你的火把灭了。
lines.en: We collide and your torch goes out.

lines.zh: 我绕过你，你不值得翻。
lines.en: I go around you; you are not worth turning.

lines.zh: 两本书靠在一起会互相涂改。
lines.en: Two books leaning together edit each other.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是一册被烧掉一半的日记。
lines.en: My mate is a diary burned halfway through.

lines.zh: 我们交换页，直到分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: We trade pages until neither of us is certain.

lines.zh: 它的封皮是皮，我的是布。
lines.en: Its cover is leather; mine is cloth.

lines.zh: 我们不生育，只互相抄写。
lines.en: We do not breed; we only copy one another.

lines.zh: 它读我时，我听见自己的字变了。
lines.en: When it reads me, I hear my words change.

lines.zh: 我们合上，就是一本更厚的书。
lines.en: Closed together, we are one thicker book.

lines.zh: 它缺了最后一页，我没有补。
lines.en: It lacks a final page, and I did not supply one.

lines.zh: 夜里我们并排立着，谁也不翻。
lines.en: At night we stand side by side, neither turning.

lines.zh: 别把我们放在同一格书架上。
lines.en: Do not shelve the two of us in the same slot.

lines.zh: 你捡起我掉的页，上面有血。
lines.en: You pick up a page I dropped; there is blood on it.

lines.zh: 那页是空白的，你敢写吗。
lines.en: That page is blank; dare you write on it?

lines.zh: 你把纸角抚平，字就淡了。
lines.en: You smooth the corner and the letters fade.

lines.zh: 别把散页夹进别的书。
lines.en: Do not tuck my loose pages into other books.

lines.zh: 你捡起的墨点会留在掌心。
lines.en: The ink dot you pick up will stay in your palm.

lines.zh: 那些碎页会自己找回来。
lines.en: Those torn pages will find their way back.

lines.zh: 你把它对着光看，看见一只眼。
lines.en: Hold it to the light and an eye looks back.

lines.zh: 你塞进背包，我听见拉链响。
lines.en: You put it in your pack; I hear the zip.

lines.zh: 那页写着你明天的死法。
lines.en: That page describes how you die tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你收好它，它也会收好你。
lines.en: Keep it safe, and it will keep you safe.

lines.zh: 你翻开了我，规矩就定了。
lines.en: You opened me, so the rules are set.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我刚刚读到了。
lines.en: I have just read your name.

lines.zh: 你踩了我掉的那页。
lines.en: You stepped on the page I dropped.

lines.zh: 你在我的页边画了线。
lines.en: You drew a line in my margin.

lines.zh: 那座塔里的传说，就是我。
lines.en: The legend in that tower is me.

lines.zh: 你带的剑，砍不断纸。
lines.en: That sword of yours cannot cut paper.

lines.zh: 你身上有凋灵的味道，巧了。
lines.en: You smell of the Wither; how convenient.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你识字。
lines.en: I choose you because you can read.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我记下了。
lines.en: You smiled once; I noted it.

lines.zh: 书页开始翻动，停在你那页。
lines.en: My pages turn and stop at yours.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上那道旧咒在回应我。
lines.en: That old curse on your armor answers me.

lines.zh: 别跑，纸比腿快得多。
lines.en: Do not run; paper outpaces legs.

lines.zh: 我从页缝里抽出一线光。
lines.en: I draw a thread of light from between pages.

lines.zh: 刀刃在成形，你听见嗡声了吗。
lines.en: The blade is forming; do you hear the hum?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找护甲的缝。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting for an armor seam.

lines.zh: 我翻到那一页，字开始发红。
lines.en: I turn to that page and the letters redden.

lines.zh: 你举盾，纸刃会绕过去。
lines.en: Hold up your shield; the paper blade goes around.

lines.zh: 我在你背后翻开自己。
lines.en: I open myself behind you.

lines.zh: 我的字在爬，爬到你的名字上。
lines.en: My words crawl until they reach your name.

lines.zh: 你退一步，页就长一寸。
lines.en: You step back and my page grows an inch.

lines.zh: 我不急，墨水还有很多。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; there is plenty of ink.

lines.zh: 那道红光在你甲上找接口。
lines.en: That red glow is seeking a joint in your armor.

lines.zh: 你听见翻页声了吗，那是我在瞄准。
lines.en: Hear that page turn? That is me aiming.

lines.zh: 我等你举剑，那时你空门大开。
lines.en: I wait for your sword to rise, leaving you open.

lines.zh: 我的页数在减少，威力在增加。
lines.en: My page count drops as my power climbs.

lines.zh: 页刃切过你的甲缝，见了血。
lines.en: The page blade crosses your seam and finds blood.

lines.zh: 我从书页抽刀，一刀划过你手臂。
lines.en: I pull a blade from a page and slash your arm.

lines.zh: 刀刃变红了，诅咒顺着伤口爬。
lines.en: The blade turns red and the curse crawls in.

lines.zh: 这一划，你的护甲开始收紧。
lines.en: With this cut your armor begins to tighten.

lines.zh: 我夹住你的手指，往里压。
lines.en: I clamp your fingers and press inward.

lines.zh: 墨泼进你眼睛，你眨了。
lines.en: Ink splashes your eyes and you blink.

lines.zh: 纸边比铁还利，你信了吗。
lines.en: A paper edge is sharper than iron; believe it now?

lines.zh: 我用书脊砸你的膝，很疼吧。
lines.en: I swing my spine into your knee; it stings.

lines.zh: 刀锋带走一片皮，留在页里。
lines.en: The blade takes a strip of skin and files it away.

lines.zh: 你砍我，只砍掉几行字。
lines.en: You cut me and only remove a few lines.

lines.zh: 有人在废墟里念完了最后一页。
lines.en: Someone finished the last page in the ruins.

lines.zh: 我被放逐到这里，落地成册。
lines.en: I was banished here and landed as a volume.

lines.zh: 书架倒了，我从灰里立起来。
lines.en: The shelf fell and I rose from the ash.

lines.zh: 封印的锁扣自己弹开了。
lines.en: The sealing clasp sprang open by itself.

lines.zh: 这一带的字都往我身上聚。
lines.en: Every written word nearby gathers into me.

lines.zh: 地窖里那盏灯灭时，我醒了。
lines.en: When the cellar lamp went out, I woke.

lines.zh: 我带着上一任读者的血出生。
lines.en: I was born with the last reader's blood in me.

lines.zh: 有人把我从火堆里踢出来。
lines.en: Someone kicked me out of a bonfire.

lines.zh: 墓室的墙上，我学会了走路。
lines.en: I learned to walk along a tomb wall.

lines.zh: 我的第一句话是别人的遗言。
lines.en: My first sentence was someone's last words.

lines.zh: 那本书被撕碎，碎页拼成了我。
lines.en: That book was torn apart, and its scraps made me.

lines.zh: 月光翻开了我，我就活了。
lines.en: Moonlight opened me, and I came alive.

lines.zh: 我出生时，附近的墨都干了。
lines.en: When I was born, all the nearby ink dried.

lines.zh: 别问我被谁放逐，问就是它怕我。
lines.en: Do not ask who banished me; they feared me.

lines.zh: 火舔上封皮，我闻到自己烧焦的味道。
lines.en: Fire licks my cover and I smell myself burning.

lines.zh: 我从半空跌下，页散了一地。
lines.en: I fall from the air and my pages scatter.

lines.zh: 水泡开我的字，我在慢慢消失。
lines.en: Water soaks my letters and I slowly cease.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撕成纸屑，又聚回来。
lines.en: The blast shreds me to scraps, and I gather again.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我，孔边自己长好了。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and the hole closes itself.

lines.zh: 魔法想改写我，我把它涂掉了。
lines.en: Magic tries to rewrite me, so I blot it out.

lines.zh: 太久没人读，我的字开始褪色。
lines.en: Unread too long, my words begin to fade.

lines.zh: 雷点燃了我的页边，我拍灭了。
lines.en: Lightning lit my page edge, and I beat it out.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有字，那才是真的死。
lines.en: The void holds no words, and that is true death.
